temporal_design: global scan_date cutoff; early <= empirical 0.75 quantile, late > cutoff

variants.E0_SOURCE_RUT: existing PhreshPhish RUT URL+Text encoders, frozen
variants.E1_TARGET_RUT: same RUT encoders plus one MLM epoch on unlabeled early Putra target pool

primary_endpoint: normalized area under AP learning curve over log10(label budget)
primary_test: two-sided exact paired sign-flip test over N10 AULC differences
secondary_AP_family: four paired AP tests, Holm-corrected across label budgets
